Test the in-space material properties of various 3D printed polymers.
Description

Test the in-space material properties of various 3D printed polymers to prepare for using them in the ISS-based fabrication of MakerSat-1.

Failure cause Broken solar cells reduced power generation by 40% and power budget went negative until science mission stopped. Afterwards several beacons received per day when batteries partially charged.
